_comment: Ceph RGW (Squid 19.2.6, single node, teran/ceph-container): plain S3 behaviour for what it_s3_backend checks. Capabilities from the read-only probes (bucket without object lock: legal hold / retention cannot be told, hence Unknown). Website is off in RGW by default (405); ?ownershipControls is ignored and answered with a listing.
_copyKeepsTags: A copy onto itself with metadata directive REPLACE drops the object's tags, even with an explicit x-amz-tagging-directive COPY; sending them along (directive REPLACE + x-amz-tagging) keeps them. Verified 2026-10-21.
_headReportsDeleteMarker: HEAD / GET on a key whose current entry is a delete marker answer a bare 404 (no x-amz-delete-marker), also for the marker's own version id; CopyObject sends neither x-amz-copy-source-version-id nor x-amz-version-id. Verified 2026-10-21.
_configWrite: Bucket configuration writes (it_s3_backend bucketConfigWriteAndRemove): written to a guarded scratch bucket, read back, removed. false: the backend refuses (never with a CreateBucket / DeleteBucket answer).
_conditionalOverwrite: Ceph RGW 19.2.6 (Docker): If-Match on PutObject is compared with the unquoted ETag — the RFC form (quoted) is refused even when it matches; CompleteMultipartUpload ignores If-Match and overwrites. Unusable: CephProfile knows object.conditional-overwrite as Unsupported.
